function.name: get_top_items
function.description: Best-selling menu items in a date range, by quantity or revenue.

date_from.description: 'today', 'yesterday', '-N' (N days ago: '-1' is yesterday) or YYYY-MM-DD. Omit both dates = today only; one date = that day only.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: 'today', 'yesterday', '-N' (N days ago: '-1' is yesterday) or YYYY-MM-DD. Omit both dates = today only; one date = that day only.
date_to.title: Date To

category.description: Turkish category name, e.g. 'Çorbalar'. Unknown names return the list.
category.title: Category

limit.description: How many the user asked for: 'top 5' = 5.
limit.title: Limit

user_message.description: Optional: the user's latest message, copied word for word. Read tools return data to describe yourself, not a sentence to copy, so pass this to get a reminder of which language to answer in.
user_message.title: User Message
